senses.zh_definition: 惠特克：英语来源的姓氏，具体中文译写依人物既定译名而定。
senses.en_definition: An English-origin surname, conventionally written Whitaker.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga yang berasal daripada bahasa Inggeris dan dieja Whitaker.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，正文应首字母大写。无法仅凭此姓氏确定具体人物。资料包没有提供 DBP 定义；本条马来语释义为编辑说明，status 仅沿用指定输出标签，不表示已获 DBP 收录认证。以下为自然姓名组合，无频率排名依据。

etymology.historical_story: Whitaker is a surname shaped by English place names. A family-name dictionary associates it with places whose Old English elements mean white field; another possible line involves wheat field. Such names identified people through places associated with them. These historical elements explain the surname's background, but they are not productive word parts in modern Malay. [Dictionary of American Family Names](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/Whitaker)
